$comment: The freshness registry (agent/plans/PLAN-ci-consolidation.md Part B). Each entry is one
committed artifact that a LIVE producer rewrites from real CI data, and the check that
compares the committed file with fresh measurements. Read only by
runs every entry whose `cadence` names that cadence and exits 1 when any check fails;
`--list` prints the registry; `--refresh <artifact>` runs that entry's producers in order.
Keys per entry, all required and no others: `artifact` (repo-relative path, must exist),
`producers` (argv lists, run in order by --refresh), `check` (one argv), `network` (true
when the check reads GitHub, so a token is needed), `cadence` (a non-empty subset of
["pr", "nightly"]). Every argv runs from the repo root with PYTHONPATH=.ci.
The shrink-only debt baselines (docker-image, devcontainer, embed, search-index
freshness) are a different class and do not belong here: they are frozen findings,
not caches of a live measurement (agent/reports/consolidation-investigation-2026-10-04.md
section 3). lane-durations.json has two producers because
check_job_timeout_headroom.py --refresh owns its `job_max_seconds` section and stamps
that section's own refreshed_at (that script's module docstring, RETIRED INTO).
